menu "Memory Management"

config MEM_ATTR
	bool "Memory attributes management library"
	help
	  This option enables the memory attributes management library. Enable
	  this to parse collect and manage the memory regions and their
	  attributes listed in the DT using the 'zephyr,memory-attr'
	  property.

if MEM_ATTR

config MEM_ATTR_HEAP
	bool "Memory dynamic allocator based on memory attributes"
	select SYS_MEM_BLOCKS
	help
	  Allow allocating memory using reference to memory attributes by means
	  of an internal heap allocator using the defined regions.

endif # MEM_ATTR

endmenu
